first_sentence.value: Though the ensuing COLLECT and preceding SPECIMEN DAYS are both largely from memoranda already existing, the hurried peremptory needs of copy for the printers, already referr'd to - (the musicians' story of a composer up in a garret rushing the middle body and last of his score together, while the fiddlers are playing the first parts down in the concert-room) - of this haste, while quite willing to get the consequent stimulus of life and motion, I am sure there must have resulted sundry technical errors.
